facts.name: Full UI parity
facts.label: UNVERIFIED
facts.cite: No authenticated same-state reference screenshot comparison. These are component-scoped extracted facts, not a completed visual parity result.

facts.name: Native select replacement
facts.label: UNVERIFIED
facts.cite: LM uses custom Select via HQe/Wg. Our native select retains platform interaction/appearance; custom caret, menu geometry and focus behavior remain unimplemented.

facts.name: Effects and alternate states
facts.label: UNVERIFIED
facts.cite: Hover expansion/timing, touch controls, mobile layout, responsive sidebar constraints and resize behavior are not implemented here.

facts.label: UNVERIFIED
